description: Dark mode for the PUBLIC respondent form and the editor FormPreviewPage (scope: public/preview only; dashboard/editor untouched). Default to OS preference via prefers-color-scheme with a persisted manual light/dark toggle (localStorage key qivo-color-scheme) overriding the OS default. Drive everything from a single data-color-scheme attribute on document.documentElement plus centralized CSS variables, so one override block flips all public-form surfaces. Compose with per-form theming: the form's accentColor still wins (buttons/accents), dark mode governs neutrals/surfaces/text/borders. Pinned background rule: a form's custom backgroundColor is respected in LIGHT mode; in DARK mode the neutral surface is overridden by the dark page background so text stays readable (owner's light background is not shown in dark); the cover image shows in both. Avoid a flash of wrong theme via a tiny inline script in index.html. Independent of FEAT-002 at the file level but ordered first because the focus-ring and surface variables it introduces must exist in both schemes before the a11y pass adds focus styles and grouped-control markup.
steps: In apps/web/src/App.css, EXTEND the existing :root { --qivo-* } token block (~line 2368) with semantic public-form surface variables set to today's LIGHT hex: --qivo-page-bg, --qivo-card-bg, --qivo-surface, --qivo-surface-2, --qivo-text, --qivo-text-secondary, --qivo-text-muted, --qivo-border, --qivo-border-strong, --qivo-input-bg, --qivo-input-border, --qivo-placeholder, --qivo-error-text, --qivo-focus-ring. Reuse existing --qivo-* where they already match.

In apps/web/src/App.css, convert the hard-coded hex in the public-form rules to reference the new variables: .public-form-shell (base bg), .public-form-body, .public-form-title/.public-form-description/.public-section-counter, .question-field > label/legend, .question-label, .question-description, .question-field input/textarea (background/color/border and ::placeholder), .choice-item/.rating-item (base + :hover + selected via input:checked), .rating-labels, .field-error, .submit-error (keep .payment-warning distinct), .secondary-button, .public-status-card + its h1/p/brand, .public-progress-bar/.public-progress-fill, .public-form-brand/.public-status-brand. Do not change the editor/dashboard rules.

In apps/web/src/App.css, add ONE override block `[data-color-scheme="dark"] { ... }` that redefines ONLY neutrals/surfaces/text/borders to dark values chosen for WCAG AA text contrast (suggested: page #0f172a, card/surface #1e293b, surface-2 #111827, text #f1f5f9, text-secondary #cbd5e1, text-muted #94a3b8, border #334155, input-bg #111827, input-border #475569, placeholder #94a3b8, error-text #fca5a5, focus-ring a visible blue/cyan). Do NOT redefine --qivo-primary or any accent token — the per-form accent must still win. Optionally add a @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) block guarded so no-JS still themes, but the JS attribute (step from FEAT-001 index.html + toggle) is the primary driver.

Move dark-unfriendly inline hex into variable-driven CSS classes. Add classes .upload-dropzone, .upload-hint, .upload-progress-track, .upload-progress-fill, .multi-entry-input, .multi-entry-remove, .multi-entry-add, .signature-hint, .quiz-score-card, .color-scheme-toggle — each using the new variables, each with a dark override in the [data-color-scheme="dark"] block where needed. Replace the corresponding inline style hex in apps/web/src/pages/PublicFormPage.tsx (FILE_UPLOAD dropzone, SIGNATURE saved block, MULTI_ENTRY inputs/remove/add buttons, success-screen score card #f0fdf4 box) and apps/web/src/components/SignaturePad.tsx (wrapper border/bg, 'Sign above' hint, Clear button) with these classes. Keep SignaturePad's disabled opacity/pointer-events inline logic, and keep the <canvas> opaque-white backgroundColor unchanged (PNG export fidelity) — only the wrapper follows the theme.

Create apps/web/src/lib/colorScheme.ts exporting COLOR_SCHEME_KEY = "qivo-color-scheme", getStoredScheme() (localStorage read -> 'light'|'dark'|null, guarded), setStoredScheme(scheme), resolveInitialScheme() (stored value, else matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') -> 'dark', else 'light'), applyScheme(scheme) (sets document.documentElement.dataset.colorScheme). DOM-guard every function (typeof document/localStorage/window === 'undefined') so it is unit-testable in the node env, mirroring apps/web/src/lib/theme.ts.

Add a minimal inline <script> in apps/web/index.html <head>, BEFORE the /src/main.tsx module script, that reads localStorage['qivo-color-scheme'] (try/catch), falls back to matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)'), and sets document.documentElement.dataset.colorScheme synchronously to avoid a flash of the wrong theme. No imports, keep it tiny.

Create apps/web/src/components/ColorSchemeToggle.tsx: a single <button type="button"> with aria-pressed reflecting dark-on and an aria-label ('Switch to dark mode'/'Switch to light mode'), a non-color icon (sun/moon glyph, aria-hidden) plus visually-hidden text. Initialize local state from document.documentElement.dataset.colorScheme (default via resolveInitialScheme in an effect to avoid SSR mismatch). On click toggle light<->dark, call applyScheme + setStoredScheme, and invoke an optional onChange(scheme) prop. Style with .color-scheme-toggle (variable-driven, visible focus ring in both schemes). No new dependency.

Wire <ColorSchemeToggle> into apps/web/src/pages/PublicFormPage.tsx inside .public-form-header (top-right) on the main form view, and into apps/web/src/pages/FormPreviewPage.tsx in the same header spot.

Make dark mode win over a per-form custom background: in both pages, apply resolved.background inline to .public-form-shell ONLY when the active scheme is light (e.g. read document.documentElement.dataset.colorScheme into state and gate the inline style), OR set it as a CSS variable --qivo-form-bg that the [data-color-scheme="dark"] block overrides with --qivo-page-bg. Keep resolved.accent and resolved.coverImageUrl applied in BOTH schemes. Preserve resolveTheme/ensureFontLoaded behavior and the inline accent on buttons/eyebrow.

Add unit tests. apps/web/src/lib/colorScheme.test.ts: stub document/localStorage/matchMedia under the node env (mirror theme.test.ts installDocumentStub) and assert resolveInitialScheme precedence (stored > matchMedia > light), applyScheme sets documentElement.dataset.colorScheme, and set/getStoredScheme round-trips. apps/web/src/components/ColorSchemeToggle.test.tsx: renderToStaticMarkup the toggle in each state and assert aria-pressed="true"/"false" and the correct aria-label text.
acceptance_criteria: `cd apps/web && pnpm build` compiles with no type errors.
`cd apps/web && pnpm test` passes, including the new colorScheme.test.ts and ColorSchemeToggle.test.tsx, and all baseline suites remain green.

Dark mode is driven solely by document.documentElement[data-color-scheme] plus the centralized CSS variables (no per-component second color set beyond the variable-driven classes); the toggle persists to localStorage key qivo-color-scheme and OS prefers-color-scheme is the default when nothing is stored.

Per-form accentColor still applies in dark mode (buttons/eyebrow accent unchanged); a per-form custom light backgroundColor is shown in light mode but overridden by the dark page background in dark mode; the cover image shows in both schemes.
No regression to inline validation, piping, theming, payment button, skip logic, or any question type's rendering/behavior.
findings:
IMPLEMENTED. Dark mode for public form + editor preview, driven by document.documentElement[data-color-scheme].

NEW FILES:
- apps/web/src/lib/colorScheme.ts — exports: COLOR_SCHEME_KEY='qivo-color-scheme'; type ColorScheme='light'|'dark'; getStoredScheme(): ColorScheme|null (localStorage, guarded+try/catch, invalid values -> null); setStoredScheme(scheme) (guarded, swallows write errors); resolveInitialScheme(): ColorScheme (stored > matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') > 'light'); applyScheme(scheme) (sets document.documentElement.dataset.colorScheme, no-op without document). All DOM/window/localStorage guarded for node-env tests.
- apps/web/src/lib/colorScheme.test.ts — node-env stubs for localStorage/document/window+matchMedia.
- apps/web/src/components/ColorSchemeToggle.tsx — default export; props { onChange?: (scheme: ColorScheme) => void }. Single <button type=button class=color-scheme-toggle> with aria-pressed (true when dark), aria-label 'Switch to dark mode'/'Switch to light mode', aria-hidden sun(\u2600)/moon(\u263E) glyph + .visually-hidden label text. Seeds state from documentElement.dataset.colorScheme (falls back to resolveInitialScheme). Effect only calls applyScheme (no setState-in-effect). On click flips light<->dark: applyScheme + setStoredScheme + onChange.
- apps/web/src/components/ColorSchemeToggle.test.tsx — renderToStaticMarkup, stubs document to assert aria-pressed/aria-label per state.

CONTRACT — data-color-scheme attribute: set on document.documentElement; values 'light'|'dark'. Written synchronously pre-paint by an inline <script> in apps/web/index.html (before /src/main.tsx), then by the toggle. It is the SOLE driver of dark mode. prefers-color-scheme is the default only when nothing is stored.

CSS (apps/web/src/App.css): EXTENDED the :root token block with semantic surface vars (today's light hex): --qivo-page-bg, --qivo-card-bg, --qivo-surface, --qivo-surface-2, --qivo-text, --qivo-text-secondary, --qivo-text-muted, --qivo-border, --qivo-border-strong, --qivo-input-bg, --qivo-input-border, --qivo-placeholder, --qivo-error-text, --qivo-focus-ring. ONE override block [data-color-scheme="dark"]{...} flips ONLY these to dark values (page #0f172a, card/surface #1e293b, surface-2 #111827, text #f1f5f9, text-secondary #cbd5e1, text-muted #94a3b8, border #334155, border-strong/input-border #475569, input-bg #111827, error-text #fca5a5, focus-ring rgb(56 189 248 / 45%)). --qivo-primary and inline per-form accent are NEVER redefined. Public-form rules (.public-form-shell/-title/-description/-section-counter/-body, .question-field label/legend/input/textarea + ::placeholder + :focus, .choice-item/.rating-item incl :hover and :has(input:checked) selected, .rating-labels, .field-error, .submit-error, .public-status-card + h1/p, .public-progress-bar/-fill, .public-status-brand/.public-form-brand) now reference the vars. .submit-error.payment-warning kept DISTINCT (amber) in both schemes via its own dark rule. .secondary-button dark override is scoped under '.public-form-shell' so the dashboard is untouched.

NEW VARIABLE-DRIVEN CLASSES (replace former inline hex): .upload-dropzone, .upload-hint, .upload-progress-track, .upload-progress-fill, .multi-entry-input (+::placeholder), .multi-entry-remove, .multi-entry-add, .signature-hint, .signature-clear, .quiz-score-card (+ .quiz-score-label/.quiz-score-value/.quiz-score-percent; green card has its own dark override), .color-scheme-toggle (+ .visually-hidden, + .public-form-header positioning so the toggle sits top-right). SignaturePad <canvas> keeps its opaque-white backgroundColor (PNG export); only the wrapper (.upload-dropzone) follows the theme and keeps disabled opacity/pointer-events inline.

PINNED BACKGROUND CONTRACT: pages pass a per-form custom background as the CSS var --qivo-form-bg (inline style on .public-form-shell), NOT as `background`. .public-form-shell uses background: var(--qivo-form-bg, var(--qivo-page-bg)); the un-themed decorative gradient is applied via .public-form-shell:not([style*="--qivo-form-bg"]). The dark block sets --qivo-form-bg: var(--qivo-page-bg) AND overrides the shell background to the dark page bg, so a custom LIGHT background shows in light mode only. resolved.coverImageUrl and resolved.accent still apply in BOTH schemes. resolveTheme/ensureFontLoaded unchanged.

WIRING: <ColorSchemeToggle/> rendered as first child of <header className=public-form-header> in both apps/web/src/pages/PublicFormPage.tsx and FormPreviewPage.tsx. Imported 'type CSSProperties' from react in both pages to type the --qivo-form-bg inline style.

VERIFICATION (this commit): `pnpm test` 90 passed / 10 files (incl. the 2 new suites). `pnpm build` (tsc -b && vite build) compiles clean. `pnpm lint` = 16 problems — ALL pre-existing in untouched files (TeamPage/DashboardPage/AdminPanelPage/FormEditorPage/FormReportsPage/ResponseDashboardPage/StatCards/WebhooksTabPanel + the pre-existing _r/_removed destructuring-omit and Date.now purity errors in unmodified regions of PublicFormPage/FormPreviewPage). Baseline (pre-change) lint was already 16; my changes add ZERO new lint errors. FEAT-002 (a11y) can rely on --qivo-focus-ring + the surface vars now existing in both schemes.
